schemaMap.rowIdentity: The integer value in 'Ageing Sets'; RPT0 is 0 and RPT8 is 8.
schemaMap.bol_r_0_1s_ohm: RPT0 '0.1s Resistance [Ohms]' from the Performance Summary.
schemaMap.capacity_retention_rpt8: RPT8 'C/10 Capacity [mA h]' divided by RPT0 'C/10 Capacity [mA h]'.

gittMap.member: The cell's 'RPT0 - 25-pulse GITT 0.5C discharge data.csv' member under Processed Timeseries Data/GITT Voltage Curves.
gittMap.pulseOnset: A row whose current is below -100 mA and whose preceding row is at least -100 mA.
gittMap.prePulseVoltage: Median of the last three zero-current samples within 0.5 s before the selected onset.
gittMap.tenSecondSample: The sample nearest 10.000 s after onset, required to be within 0.051 s and below -100 mA.
gittMap.bol_r_10s_ohm: (pre-pulse voltage - ten-second voltage) / absolute ten-second current in amperes.
gittMap.bol_r_10s_minus_0_1s_ohm: bol_r_10s_ohm minus the Performance Summary bol_r_0_1s_ohm.

pilotChecks.reasonForTolerance: The source SoH column differs by a few parts per million from the direct C/10 RPT8/RPT0 ratio, consistent with source-side numeric processing. The preregistered direct ratio remains the response.

unchangedContracts: The response remains the direct RPT8-to-RPT0 C/10 capacity ratio.
The three feature arms and their order are unchanged.
Ridge alpha remains 1.0 and all prediction gates are unchanged.
Pilot rows remain excluded from fitting and metrics.
